test_cases_present: partial - the spec defines mandatory protocol behaviors (frame format, arbitration, error handling, fault confinement) that map directly to compliance test scenarios but does not provide a formal testbench.
derived_compliance_test_categories: DATA FRAME with each DLC value 0..8.
DATA FRAME identifier corner cases (lowest priority identifier, highest priority identifier, constraint 'ID-10..ID-4 not all recessive').
REMOTE FRAME (RTR=recessive) request → matching DATA FRAME response.
Bitwise arbitration with two and three nodes starting simultaneously.
Arbitration loss: identifier mismatch at first differing bit; loser withdraws.
CRC mismatch → CRC ERROR → ACTIVE ERROR FLAG generation.
STUFF ERROR injection (6 consecutive identical bits in stuffed field).
FORM ERROR injection (illegal bit in CRC DELIMITER / ACK DELIMITER / EOF / INTERMISSION).
ACKNOWLEDGMENT ERROR (no dominant ACK after transmitter recessive ACK SLOT).
BIT ERROR (transmitted bit ≠ monitored bit; except in arbitration recessive→dominant and ACK SLOT recessive→dominant).
Fault confinement counter transitions: error-active → error-passive (count ≥128) → bus-off (TX count ≥256) → error-active recovery (128 × 11 recessive bits).
Wake-up sequence (sleep node receives dominant transition + 11 consecutive recessive bits).
